selection: Seeds fixed before looking at results. Six equally spaced indices floor(k*N/min(6,N)) in each deterministic proposal list. Lists may change with the algorithm; this is a map-level survey, not paired site matching. No rerolls.
generation_count: All scout proposals under a map-area work budget, no target count. Six is a measurement sample, not a generated-trail quota.
source: Complete production worlds at WorldGenerator.PLAN_SIZE with unchanged heights, water, rivers and infrastructure. Baseline inherits the old 2 m cap; final automatic Lab construction has no depth cap and ranks earthwork cost. Terrain fingerprints exclude policy, project source fingerprints include it.
timing: Separate source_open_ms (observed load/generation), source_ms and game_stages_ms (original snapshot generation provenance), search_ms, project_ms with walk/base/composition/feature fitting, preparation, physical probe, total, first_built/first_ready/first_physical. Background processes overlapped; timings are observations, not an isolated benchmark. Compare first_ready_ms-source_open_ms for pipeline time on initially uncached worlds.
scope: Trail Labs only; shared input supports an explicit unlimited flag, absent in the main game. No game integration.
design: A shared allowed footprint and actual terrain interpolation. Slope, width, construction cost and character rank choices rather than prohibit them. Automatic construction uses ordinary shaping without the old 2 m cap or its natural-grade-following override. Character is evaluated with composition, not required from a bare flat line. No separate endpoint solver.
